verified_counts.generated_cpu_report_note: The same eight original CPU dots are reported in each of three variant rows; they execute once per generated case, not three times.

implementation: Each independent128/256/512-element chunk starts at zero and retains all original K32 alpha multiplies. Two zero-C BF16 WMMAs per K16 supply signed and absolute partials; explicit FP32 additions retain chunk centers and unweighted positive sums. A second consumer scales its incoming center with every original alpha in order, adds the partial, and propagates a conservative envelope. Original probability generation, denominator, reciprocal, candidate collector and exact replay kernels are unchanged. Every actual candidate comes from this producer and its own interval. No model dispatcher includes the new header.
bound_scope: The envelope is conditional on the existing2^-19 native zero-C signed and positive WMMA error coefficient. Host cases perturb both matrix results within this assumption and check every declared canonical prefix. The envelope accounts for all original17 aligned terms and FP32 K16 normalization, canonical K32 rescale rounding, the independent entry-only rescale chain, native explicit additions and final addition. Every accepted original operand is zero or has BF16 exponent80..174. Invalid operands or nonfinite intervals retain original exact replay. This is not a proof of the hardware coefficient.
correctness_scope: Generated cases run all-cell original exact PV as their GPU reference and eight independent wide CPU recurrences per case. Every finite candidate interval is checked against the canonical final FP32 result, then every corrected BF16 output is compared. All generated modes, both denominator orders, partial tiles, output prefixes, arbitrary signs, zeros, subnormals, large and NaN values, actual candidate uniqueness/counts, probability and scale immutability and output/part workspace guards pass. Captured runs compare all corrected BF16 outputs with the selected original pipeline, all first7169 rows with the external GB10 context, exact denominator bits and independent selected CPU raw accumulators. All warmups and samples are checked. These are operator captures, not real q8192 model tokens.
timing_scope: One warmup and three measurements per slab rotate the original and all three candidates. Timers include native producer, transfer consumer, actual candidate collection, unchanged exact replay and GPU completion. Common QK, probability generation, Q/K preparation and value transpose are reported separately. Allocation, guard fills, host transfer, candidate/guard validation and CPU references are outside component clocks. The reported workspace is the required live capacity for128 queries and that chunk size; the fixture allocates the maximum128-element chunk capacity for all arms.

decision.decision: Keep the component isolated and retain the tested coarse OUT whole-provider control. All original GB10 operator endpoints pass, but every128/256/512-element transfer variant increases actual candidate replay and completed producer/consumer/collection/replay time at both full component shapes. No model dispatch or release qualification follows. Seek a structural route preserving candidate admission or reducing original arithmetic without adding conservative replay.
